'''Quetzathog''' is a miniboss in [[The Shadow Reef]]. It appears to be the unofficial leader of the [[sea horror]]s.

It is the author of one of the [[waterlogged scrap]]s, where it learns of [[Tezcasathla|its god]]'s alternative name of [[Xau-Tak]] after hearing it from [[The Ambassador]]. Quetzathog was perplexed by the god's alternative name, but did not question it further as the Ambassador promised to help the mwanu reclaim their old world.

==Trivia==
* Its name is a portmanteau referring to {{WP|Quetzalcoatl}}, an Aztec god, and either {{WP|Tsathoggua}} and/or {{WP|Cthulhu Mythos deities#Table of Great Old Ones|Thog}}, deities from the Cthulhu Mythos.
